articles.title_en: Optimal tree contest design and winner-take-all
articles.title_cn: 最优树形竞赛设计与赢者通吃
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effort-maximizing design of multi-stage contests with tree-like architectures, focusing on both contest architecture and prize structure. Given the architecture, we show that the whole budget should be assigned to a single match. This match must be the final if the architecture is symmetric. Moreover, the winner-take-all rule proves to be optimal if the contest organizer can jointly design the architecture and prize structure. To determine the optimal contest architecture, we use dynamic programming and induction to provide a tight upper bound for the optimized total effort level. Our new approach extends the findings of Gradstein and Konrad (1999), offering new insights into how the optimal architecture hinges on the noise level of matches.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有树状结构的多阶段竞赛中努力最大化的设计问题，重点关注竞赛架构和奖金结构。在给定架构的情况下，我们表明全部预算应分配给单场比赛。如果架构是对称的，这场比赛必须是决赛。此外，如果竞赛组织者能够联合设计架构和奖金结构，赢者通吃规则被证明是最优的。为了确定最优竞赛架构，我们使用动态规划和归纳法为优化后的总努力水平提供了一个紧的上界。我们的新方法扩展了Gradstein和Konrad（1999）的发现，为最优架构如何依赖于比赛的噪声水平提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: The value of and demand for diverse news sources
articles.title_cn: 多样化新闻来源的价值与需求
articles.abstract_en: We study the value of and the demand for instrumentally-valuable information in a simple decision environment where signals are transparently polarized. We find that in both information aggregation and acquisition, subjects use sophisticated heuristics to counter the polarization in signals. A minority of subjects (15%) produce precise Bayesian reports, while an additional 59% of subjects produce unbiased reports even when exposed to polarized signals. Subjects placed in a market place of information rarely end up buying polarized signals and instead overwhelmingly opt for diverse information. The demand for diverse information increases as diverse information becomes more valuable and decreases as it becomes more expensive.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在一个信号透明极化的简单决策环境中，工具性价值信息的需求与价值。我们发现，在信息聚合和获取中，受试者使用复杂的启发式方法来对抗信号中的极化。少数受试者（15%）产生精确的贝叶斯报告，而另外59%的受试者即使在面对极化信号时也能产生无偏报告。在信息市场中的受试者很少购买极化信号，而是绝大多数选择多样化信息。对多样化信息的需求随着多样化信息价值的增加而增加，随着其成本的增加而减少。

articles.title_cn: 要么接受要么放弃的报价的普遍性
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of the option to exit in finite-horizon, two-person bargaining where players make offers alternatingly and incur fixed costs per period. We show that players use take-it-or-leave-it strategies in the unique equilibrium when there is no discounting. Expecting a low payoff at the next period as a respondent, a proposer would choose to exit after her demand were rejected. This causes her opponent to accept her take-it-or-leave-it offer. This prediction is generically valid even when the division at the final period is exogenously given, and is conditionally true when the cost of bargaining includes discounting.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在有限期界、两人讨价还价中退出选项的影响，其中参与者交替提出报价并每期承担固定成本。我们证明，在没有折现的情况下，参与者在唯一均衡中会采用要么接受要么放弃的策略。作为回应者，如果预期下一期收益较低，提议者会在其要求被拒绝后选择退出。这导致其对手接受她的要么接受要么放弃的报价。这一预测在最终阶段的分配是外生给定的情况下通常有效，并且在讨价还价成本包含折现时条件成立。

articles.title_cn: 无摩擦市场中的低效率
articles.abstract_en: Gale and Sabourian (2006) argue that Markov strategies in dynamic matching and bargaining games accommodate non-competitive behavior: with heterogeneous players, outcomes may be inefficient. In this paper, I show that their corroborating example with four players does not comprise a Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE). In fact, I show that all MPEs must be efficient in their setting with only four players. Nevertheless, I construct a continuum of inefficient equilibria in a balanced market with six players. Key to the construction is the dispersion of reservation prices to render inefficient trades individually rational, yet sufficient dynamics of continuation payoffs can be supported only with at least six players. Consequently, inefficiencies are driven by the interplay of heterogeneous valuations and strategic uncertainty from the number of players in the market.
articles.abstract_cn: Gale和Sabourian（2006）认为，动态匹配与讨价还价博弈中的马尔可夫策略容纳了非竞争性行为：在异质性参与者的情况下，结果可能是低效率的。在本文中，我表明他们关于四个参与者的佐证例子并不构成马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE）。事实上，我证明在他们的仅有四个参与者的设定中，所有MPE必须是有效率的。然而，我在一个有六个参与者的平衡市场中构建了一个连续统的低效率均衡。构建的关键在于保留价格的分散性，以使低效率交易在个体理性上可行，但延续收益的充分动态只有在至少六个参与者的情况下才能得到支持。因此，低效率是由异质性估值与市场中参与者数量带来的策略不确定性之间的相互作用驱动的。

articles.title_en: Obvious manipulations in matching with and without contracts
articles.title_cn: 有合同与无合同匹配中的明显操纵
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores many-to-one matching models, both with and without contracts, where doctors' preferences are private and hospitals' preferences are public and substitutable. It is known that any stable-dominating mechanism –which is either stable or individually rational and Pareto-dominates (from the doctors' perspective) a stable mechanism–, is susceptible to manipulation by doctors. Our study focuses on obvious manipulations and identifies stable-dominating mechanisms that prevent them. Without contracts, we show that any stable-dominating mechanism is not obviously manipulable. However, with contracts, none of these results hold. While we demonstrate that the Doctor-Proposing Deferred Acceptance (DA) Mechanism remains not obviously manipulable, we show that the Hospital-Proposing DA Mechanism and any efficient mechanism that Pareto-dominates the Doctor-Proposing DA Mechanism become (very) obviously manipulable, in the model with contracts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了有无合同的多种一对多匹配模型，其中医生的偏好是私人的，医院的偏好是公开且可替代的。已知任何稳定主导机制——即要么是稳定的，要么是个人理性的，并且（从医生的角度看）帕累托优于某个稳定机制——都容易受到医生的操纵。我们的研究聚焦于明显操纵，并识别出能够防止这些操纵的稳定主导机制。在没有合同的情况下，我们表明任何稳定主导机制都不是明显可操纵的。然而，在有合同的情况下，这些结果均不成立。虽然我们证明了医生提议的延迟接受（DA）机制仍然不是明显可操纵的，但我们表明，在有合同的模型中，医院提议的DA机制以及任何帕累托优于医生提议的DA机制的有效机制都变得（非常）明显可操纵。

articles.title_en: An implementation of the general optimal mechanism in Esö and Szentes (2007)
articles.title_cn: Esö和Szentes（2007）一般最优机制的一种实施
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we provide an implementation of the optimal mechanism of Esö and Szentes (2007) for their general environment without assuming constant marginal utility (in the first-stage type) for the buyers. Our implementation is carried out through a three-stage handicap auction. In stage 1, each buyer, knowing his first-stage type, is required to select a handicap menu by paying a menu fee. A higher menu fee would lead to a more favorable handicap menu, which charges a lower handicap fee for every possible handicap level. In stage 2, each buyer, informed of his second-stage signal, is required to select a handicap by paying a handicap fee specified by his early chosen handicap menu. In stage 3, all buyers compete for the object via a second-price auction with handicaps. The highest bidder wins and pays the sum of his chosen handicap and the second-highest bid.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们为Esö和Szentes（2007）的一般环境提供了其最优机制的一种实施，而不假设买方在第一阶段类型上具有恒定边际效用。我们的实施通过一个三阶段障碍拍卖进行。在第1阶段，每个买方在知晓其第一阶段类型后，需通过支付菜单费用选择一个障碍菜单。较高的菜单费用会导致更有利的障碍菜单，该菜单对每个可能的障碍水平收取较低的障碍费用。在第2阶段，每个买方在知晓其第二阶段信号后，需根据其早期选择的障碍菜单支付障碍费用并选择一个障碍。在第三阶段，所有买方通过带有障碍的二价拍卖竞争该物品。出价最高者获胜，并支付其选择的障碍与第二高出价之和。

articles.title_en: Auctions with signaling bidders: Optimal design and information disclosure
articles.title_cn: 具有信号传递投标人的拍卖：最优设计与信息披露
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal auctions in a symmetric private values setting, where bidders have signaling concerns: they care about winning the object and a receiver's inference about their type. Signaling concerns arise in various economic situations such as takeover bidding, charity auctions, procurement and art auctions. We show that auction revenue can be decomposed into the standard revenue from the respective auction without signaling concern, and a signaling component. The latter is the bidders' ex-ante expected signaling value net of an endogenous outside option: the signaling value for the lowest type. The revenue decomposition restores revenue equivalence between different auction designs, provided that the same information about bids is revealed. Revealing information about submitted bids affects revenue via the endogenous outside option. In general, revenue is not monotone in information revelation: revealing more information about submitted bids may reduce revenue. We show that any bid disclosure rule allowing to distinguish whether a bidder submitted a bid or abstained from participation minimizes the outside option, and therefore maximizes revenue.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在对称私人价值环境中研究最优拍卖，其中投标人具有信号传递关注：他们关心赢得物品以及接收者对其类型的推断。信号传递关注出现在各种经济情境中，如收购投标、慈善拍卖、采购和艺术品拍卖。我们表明，拍卖收入可以分解为不考虑信号传递的相应拍卖的标准收入，以及一个信号组成部分。后者是投标人的事前预期信号价值减去内生外部选项：最低类型的信号价值。收入分解恢复了不同拍卖设计之间的收入等价性，前提是披露相同的出价信息。披露提交的出价信息通过内生外部选项影响收入。一般来说，收入在信息揭示方面不是单调的：揭示更多关于提交出价的信息可能会减少收入。我们表明，任何允许区分投标人是否提交出价或未参与拍卖的出价披露规则最小化外部选项，从而最大化收入。

articles.title_cn: 无利可图博弈中的学习
articles.abstract_en: A game is unprofitable if equilibrium payoffs do not exceed the maximin payoff for each player. In an unprofitable game, Nash equilibrium play has been notoriously difficult to justify. For a class of 3×3 games we analyze whether evolutionary and learning processes lead to Nash play. We find that neither the pure Nash equilibrium nor the pure maximin strategy are stable rest points under the studied dynamics whereas the mixed Nash equilibrium and the quantal response equilibrium may be attractors, repellors or surrounded by periodic orbits.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果均衡收益不超过每个玩家的最大最小收益，则该博弈是无利可图的。在无利可图的博弈中，纳什均衡行为历来难以证明其合理性。对于一类3×3博弈，我们分析了进化过程和学习过程是否会导致纳什行为。我们发现，在所研究的动态下，纯纳什均衡和纯最大最小策略都不是稳定的静止点，而混合纳什均衡和量子响应均衡可能是吸引子、排斥子或被周期轨道包围。

articles.title_cn: 具有主观可分性的公平分配
articles.abstract_en: The classic fair division problems assume the resources to be allocated are either divisible or indivisible, or contain a mixture of both, but the agents always have a predetermined and uncontroversial agreement on the (in)divisibility of the resources. In this paper, we propose and study a new model for fair division in which agents have their own subjective divisibility over the goods to be allocated. That is, some agents may find a good to be indivisible and get utilities only if they receive the whole good, while others may consider the same good to be divisible and thus can extract utilities according to the fraction of the good they receive. We investigate fairness properties that can be achieved when agents have subjective divisibility. First, we consider the maximin share (MMS) guarantee and show that the worst-case MMS approximation guarantee is at most 2/3 for n≥2 agents and this ratio is tight in the two- and three-agent cases. This is in contrast to the classic fair division settings involving two or three agents. We also give an algorithm that produces a 1/2-MMS allocation for an arbitrary number of agents. Second, we study a hierarchy of envy-freeness relaxations, including EF1M, EFM and EFXM, ordered by increasing strength. While EF1M is compatible with non-wastefulness (an economic efficiency notion), this is not the case for EFM, even for two agents. Nevertheless, an EFXM and non-wasteful allocation always exists for two agents if at most one good is discarded.
articles.abstract_cn: 经典的公平分配问题假设待分配的资源要么是可分的，要么是不可分的，或者包含两者的混合，但代理人总是对资源的（不可）分性有预先确定且无争议的共识。在本文中，我们提出并研究了一个新的公平分配模型，其中代理人对待分配的物品具有自己的主观可分性。也就是说，一些代理人可能认为某个物品是不可分的，并且只有当他们获得整个物品时才能获得效用，而其他代理人可能认为同一物品是可分的，因此可以根据他们获得的物品比例来提取效用。我们研究了当代理人具有主观可分性时可以实现的公平性质。首先，我们考虑最大最小份额（MMS）保证，并表明对于n≥2个代理人，最坏情况下的MMS近似保证至多为2/3，并且在两个和三个代理人的情况下这个比例是紧的。这与涉及两个或三个代理人的经典公平分配设置形成对比。我们还给出了一种算法，该算法为任意数量的代理人产生一个1/2-MMS分配。其次，我们研究了一系列嫉妒自由放松的层级，包括EF1M、EFM和EFXM，按强度递增排序。虽然EF1M与非浪费性（一种经济效率概念）兼容，但EFM并非如此，即使对于两个代理人也是如此。然而，对于两个代理人，如果最多丢弃一个物品，则始终存在一个EFXM且非浪费的分配。

articles.title_en: Stable mixing in Hawk–Dove Games under best experienced payoff dynamics
articles.title_cn: 鹰鸽博弈中最优经验收益动态下的稳定混合
articles.abstract_en: The hawk–dove game admits two types of equilibria: an asymmetric pure equilibrium, in which players in one population play “hawk” and players in the other population play “dove,” and a symmetric mixed equilibrium, in which hawks are frequently matched against each other. The existing literature shows that when two populations of agents are randomly matched to play the hawk–dove game, then there is convergence to one of the pure equilibria from almost any initial state. By contrast, we show that plausible dynamics, in which agents occasionally revise their actions based on the payoffs obtained in a few trials, often give rise to the opposite result: convergence to one of the interior stationary states.
articles.abstract_cn: 鹰鸽博弈承认两种类型的均衡：一种是不对称纯均衡，其中一个群体的玩家采取“鹰”策略，另一个群体的玩家采取“鸽”策略；另一种是对称混合均衡，其中鹰策略者经常相互对抗。现有文献表明，当两个群体的代理随机配对进行鹰鸽博弈时，从几乎任何初始状态出发都会收敛到其中一个纯均衡。相比之下，我们表明，合理的动态——代理偶尔根据几次试验中获得的收益来修订其行动——往往产生相反的结果：收敛到内部静止状态之一。

articles.title_cn: 最小成本生成树博弈的比较静态分析
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a comparative static analysis for the cores of minimum-cost-spanning-tree games. We introduce a new category of cover, termed as the matrix-exact cover. Our investigation underscores the pivotal role played by the matrix-exact cover, in conjunction with the classical irreducible cost matrix. (i) When edge costs experience a decrease, the core remains invariant as long as the costs of all edges are weakly above their respective matrix-exact covers. (ii) When the costs of certain edges do fall below the matrix-exact cover, and simultaneously all edge costs remain weakly above the irreducible costs, the core contracts, forming a proper subset of the original core. (iii) Furthermore, should the costs of some edges continue to decrease and fall below the irreducible costs, the core shifts away from the original core.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对最小成本生成树博弈的核心进行了比较静态分析。我们引入了一种新的覆盖类别，称为矩阵精确覆盖。我们的研究强调了矩阵精确覆盖与经典不可约成本矩阵共同发挥的关键作用。(i) 当边成本下降时，只要所有边的成本仍弱高于其各自的矩阵精确覆盖，核心保持不变。(ii) 当某些边的成本确实低于矩阵精确覆盖，同时所有边成本仍弱高于不可约成本时，核心收缩，形成原核心的真子集。(iii) 此外，如果某些边的成本继续下降并低于不可约成本，核心将偏离原核心。

articles.title_cn: 马尔可夫选举中的问责制
articles.abstract_en: We study electoral accountability in a dynamic environment with complete information. As our normative benchmark, we take the solution of the dynamic programming problem facing the representative voter as if he chose policy directly. There always exist equilibria in which the congruent politician type, whose policy preferences match those of the voter, is accountable, in the sense that these politicians achieve the idealized benchmark. We demonstrate that challenges to electoral accountability stem from multiple equilibria with undesirable normative properties, and we give examples of novel political failures in a model of dynamic public investment. We do not allow the voter or politicians to commit. Nevertheless, we identify a class of reciprocal equilibria such that voter welfare converges to the normative benchmark, and we give conditions under which non-congruent politician types are asymptotically accountable, for every selection of such equilibria as the players become patient.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有完全信息的动态环境中研究选举问责制。作为我们的规范基准，我们采用代表性选民直接选择政策时的动态规划问题的解。总是存在均衡，其中与选民政策偏好一致的政客类型是负责任的，即这些政客能够达到理想化的基准。我们证明，选举问责制面临的挑战源于具有不良规范性质的多重均衡，并在动态公共投资模型中给出了新颖的政治失败的例子。我们不允许选民或政客做出承诺。然而，我们识别出一类互惠均衡，使得选民福利收敛于规范基准，并且我们给出了条件，在这些条件下，非一致政客类型在渐近意义上是负责任的，对于玩家变得耐心时的每一个这样的均衡选择。

articles.title_en: Going through the roof: On prices for drugs sold through insurance
articles.title_cn: 冲破屋顶：关于通过保险销售的药品价格
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies public concern grounds for high prices of drugs treating rare and debilitating diseases. We offer a theory that explains how drug indivisibility, individual budget constraints, and insurance interact to drive up drug prices, especially for drugs treating rare and severe diseases. For a broad range of drug production costs and income distributions, our model predicts that drug prices are either set at their highest levels covered by insurance or inversely related to the prevalence of the disease. In the latter case, producer profits decrease with prevalence. The effect of production costs on prices and profits is non-monotonic.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了公众对治疗罕见和衰弱性疾病的高药价担忧的依据。我们提出了一种理论，解释了药品不可分割性、个人预算约束和保险如何相互作用推高药价，尤其是针对罕见和严重疾病的药品。在广泛的药品生产成本和收入分布范围内，我们的模型预测，药品价格要么设定在保险覆盖的最高水平，要么与疾病患病率呈反比。在后一种情况下，生产者利润随患病率增加而减少。生产成本对价格和利润的影响是非单调的。
